architecture.when: package boundaries, system design, or ownership

transfer-record.when: a source candidate, historical transfer record, or detailed transfer constraints need review

drivebase.when: ESS23-RS drivebase, Modbus, encoder odometry, chassis measurements, or drive commissioning

lidar.when: STL-27L LiDAR, scan normalization, LiDAR frames, masks, or LiDAR commissioning

navigation.when: Nav2, robot_navigation, footprint, costmaps, localization, or navigation commissioning

obstacle-protection.when: STL-27L obstacle protection, OAK 4D depth, protection volumes, local safe stop, or OAK commissioning

semantic-perception.when: YOLO, Grounding DINO, SAM2, RGB-D object segmentation, grasp candidates, or manipulation perception

runtime.when: ROS 2 packages, launch, simulation, or test setup

appliance.when: systemd, customer boot, developer mode, status display, or power-on

ai-health.when: external AI health, remote AI availability, READY_LIMITED, or external AI outage handling

decisions.when: a design choice needs evidence or a rollback path
